decision.observation: 1 mph, gear 1, all dots dark. A red +5s penalty icon shows by the timer. The car is centred on the paved lane facing up-frame; a blue puddle sits mid-lane about two car lengths ahead, white posts line both edges, boulders on the left verge and a rock on the right.
decision.hypothesis: The right steer did put the car on the lane; it is now merely stalled at 1 mph. Plain W should break the stall and raise speed.
